profile.text: Botani, also known as Tishinna Viktorovna Belyaeva, is a former student of the Imperial College of Science and Engineering in Grypherburg. After withdrawing from school, she joined Rhodes Island by Operator Zima's recommendation, continuing to study Originium communications while participating in field missions.
